cbse-11-physics.note: Content marked excluded in NCERT textbooks for 2025-26 is not to be tested (PDF gives general note only; no chapter-level deletions listed).

units.name: Unit I: Physical World and Measurement
topics: Chapter 1: Units and Measurements — SI and fundamental/derived units, significant figures, uncertainty, dimensions, dimensional analysis

units.name: Unit II: Kinematics
topics: Chapter 2: Motion in a Straight Line — frame of reference, average/instantaneous velocity, uniformly accelerated motion, x-t and v-t graphs, kinematic equations (graphs and calculus)
Chapter 3: Motion in a Plane — scalars and vectors, vector addition/subtraction, unit vectors and components, scalar and vector products, projectile motion, uniform circular motion

units.name: Unit III: Laws of Motion
topics: Chapter 4: Laws of Motion — inertia, Newton's three laws, momentum and impulse, conservation of linear momentum, equilibrium of concurrent forces, static/kinetic/rolling friction, centripetal force, level and banked roads

units.name: Unit IV: Work, Energy and Power
topics: Chapter 5: Work, Energy and Power — work by constant/variable force, work-energy theorem, power, potential energy of spring, conservative and non-conservative forces, motion in vertical circle, elastic and inelastic collisions (1D, 2D)

units.name: Unit V: Motion of System of Particles and Rigid Body
topics: Chapter 6: System of Particles and Rotational Motion — centre of mass, torque, angular momentum and its conservation, equilibrium of rigid bodies, comparison of linear and rotational motion, moment of inertia, radius of gyration

units.name: Unit VI: Gravitation
topics: Chapter 7: Gravitation — Kepler's laws, universal law of gravitation, variation of g with altitude and depth, gravitational potential energy and potential, escape speed, orbital velocity, energy of satellite

units.name: Unit VII: Properties of Bulk Matter
topics: Chapter 8: Mechanical Properties of Solids — elasticity, stress-strain, Hooke's law, Young's/bulk/shear modulus, Poisson's ratio, elastic energy

Chapter 9: Mechanical Properties of Fluids — pressure due to fluid column, Pascal's law, viscosity, Stokes' law, terminal velocity, streamline/turbulent flow, Bernoulli's theorem, surface tension and capillarity

Chapter 10: Thermal Properties of Matter — thermal expansion, anomalous expansion of water, specific heat, Cp and Cv, calorimetry, latent heat, conduction/convection/radiation, Wien's and Stefan's laws

units.name: Unit VIII: Thermodynamics
topics: Chapter 11: Thermodynamics — zeroth law, heat/work/internal energy, first law, second law, state variables and equation of state, isothermal and adiabatic processes, reversible/irreversible/cyclic processes

units.name: Unit IX: Behaviour of Perfect Gases and Kinetic Theory of Gases
topics: Chapter 12: Kinetic Theory — equation of state of perfect gas, kinetic theory assumptions, pressure and kinetic interpretation of temperature, rms speed, degrees of freedom, equipartition of energy, specific heats of gases, mean free path

units.name: Unit X: Oscillations and Waves
topics: Chapter 13: Oscillations — periodic motion, SHM and its equation, phase, spring force constant, energy in SHM, simple pendulum time period
